title: A Criterion for Equidistribution along the $Ω$ Function over Polynomial Sequences with Applications
summary: Let $P (Y_1, ..., Y_d)$ be a certain fixed homogeneous polynomial of integral coefficients. In this paper, we establish a quantitative equidistribution criterion for the ergodic averages along $Ω(|P (n_1, ..., n_d)|)$.
